Question Choices: Select. When regrouping or borrowing, does total value change when we take 10 from tens and adding to ones? ~~Yes | No~~
Solution: No. One ten equals ten ones. Exchanging them changes the representation, not the total value.

Question Choices: Select. When compute 712 - 438. Which is the correct regrouped form of 712 after double regrouping? A) 600 + 100 + 12 B) 600 + 0 + 12 C) 700 + 0 + 12 ~~A | B | C~~

Solution: Regroup 712 from 700+10+2 to 600+110+2, then to 600+100+12. Select A. Subtracting 438 gives 274.
